en: Welcome to the Pokémon League. I am Lorelei of the Elite Four.
No one can match me where Ice-type Pokémon are concerned. Not even a trainer who has come this far.
Your Pokémon will be frozen where they stand. Shall we begin?
You melted my ice... How remarkable.
Go on, then. The next room is open. But the three who wait beyond are stronger than I am.
You're better than I thought. Go on ahead. You've only just had a taste of what the League can do.
